vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: zshijie-publisher
Version: 0.1.3

The zshijie-publisher skill bundle is a specialized tool for automating content publishing and editing on the Z视介 (Z-ShiJie) platform. It implements a standard QR-code-based authentication flow in scripts/publisher_cli.py, which includes logic to redact sensitive session IDs and cookies from console output to prevent accidental exposure. The skill uses legitimate dependencies (Python, Node.js, Pillow) for its operations, and its instructions in SKILL.md are strictly aligned with its stated purpose without any evidence of malicious intent, data exfiltration, or unauthorized access.

llm.summary: The skill's files, runtime instructions, and install steps are coherent with the stated purpose (QR-based login + publish/edit flows for Z视介); it requests no unrelated credentials and uses only Python and included assets to operate.

dimensions.detail: Name/description, included scripts, and bundled API spec all align: the CLI implements a QR login, extracts a sessionId, and posts publish/edit requests to the documented Z视介 endpoints. Required binary is only python3 and the brew install is limited to installing Python. The included hard-coded QR signing seed is documented in the README and is an implementation constant (not requested as a secret).
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructions stay within the skill's scope: prepare-login, display inline QR image in chat, wait-login to extract sessionId, then run publish/edit with an --input-json payload. The instructions explicitly limit which artifacts to show and instruct redaction of cookies. They do not ask the agent to read arbitrary user files or unrelated environment variables.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Install spec only offers installing Python via Homebrew (formula: python). No downloads from untrusted URLs or extraction of remote archives are present. All code needed is bundled in the skill directory.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required env vars or credentials. It obtains an authenticated session via a user scan of the QR (sessionId persisted locally). The single hard-coded signing seed is an implementation constant documented in references and is not requested from the user as a secret. No unrelated service keys or system credentials are requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false (normal). The skill writes a local session file (defaults to /tmp) and may call external tools when explicitly asked (release_to_clawhub.py can invoke 'clawhub' or 'npx clawhub@latest' if --execute is used). Autonomous invocation is permitted (platform default) — expected for an interactive publish skill, but it means the agent could initiate the QR flow when invoked.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do exactly what it claims: generate a QR for the user to scan, capture the resulting sessionId, and call the Z视介 publish/edit endpoints. Before installing or running it: (1) be prepared to show the QR in chat and to scan it with a trusted Z视介 account (the skill obtains credentials via that QR scan, not from environment variables); (2) note the skill will persist a session file in /tmp by default; (3) only run the included release_to_clawhub.py with --execute if you intend to publish to ClawHub and trust the environment's clawhub/npx tools; and (4) verify you trust the target domains (mp.cztv.com and zugcpublish.cztv.com) because the CLI will make network requests to them.
